==Description==
The '''UglyCrate''' is an event [[Crates|crate]]. It has one skin in total. It was first released for the [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. It could be bought for {{Coins|1}} in the store. Any skins that could appear in the [[Daily Store]] would also cost {{Coins|1}}.

==Trivia==
*This is the cheapest item in the entire game, excluding free items, costing {{Coins|1}} to purchase.
*This crate has the least amount of skins out of every crate, only having a single skin.
